program_src='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])
    assert n == m
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def orbit(r, c):
        return {
            (r, c), (c, r),
            (n - 1 - r, m - 1 - c), (m - 1 - c, n - 1 - r),
            (r, m - 1 - c), (m - 1 - c, r),
            (n - 1 - r, c), (c, n - 1 - r),
        }

    seen = set()
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = orbit(r, c)
            seen.update(cells)
            values = [grid[i][j] for i, j in cells if grid[i][j] != 2]
            if values:
                value = max(set(values), key=values.count)
                for i, j in cells:
                    if grid[i][j] == 2:
                        out[i][j] = value
    return out
'''
